Our Services

Flexible ways to work together.

We work across two complementary trade models: purchasing and reselling wholesale goods, and facilitating introductions or trade opportunities on a commission basis where agreed.

01 / WHOLESALE

Wholesale Purchasing & Supply

We can discuss buying and reselling suitable goods in response to business demand, with pricing, quantities and terms agreed case by case.

02 / INTERNATIONAL TRADE

Import & Export Enquiries

Exploring cross-border supply opportunities for selected consumer goods, building materials and related product categories.

03 / COMMISSION

Commission-Based Trade Introductions

Where agreed, we can help connect buyers and suppliers and discuss commission-based arrangements with responsibilities and terms defined in advance.

About KOGUS

A considered approach to international trade.

KOGUS TRADING PTY LTD is an Australian trading company focused on household and everyday goods, building materials, hardware and tools, furniture and home décor, and electronics and small appliances. We pursue wholesale purchasing and supply opportunities as well as commission-based trade introductions where agreed.

Whether you are a retailer, contractor, distributor, supplier or overseas business, we welcome enquiries that outline your products, target market, quantities and preferred trading arrangement.
